## 🚀 Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. *I'm frustrated when...*

## 💡 Proposed Solution / Feature Idea
A clear description of what feature, format token, text effect, styling parameter, or background mode you would like added.

## 🎨 Design Mockups / Examples
If applicable, attach mockups, screenshots, or examples of how you envision the feature looking or working.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, code snippets, or links related to the feature request here.
